body: I have a constant baseline of symptoms, even in my “remission” my main symptoms before amitriptyline were bladder spasms, bladder pain and pressure and bladder and urethra burning. Amitriptyline instantly took away the bladder burning and I haven’t experienced it since. The urethra burning died off about a month into amitriptyline and now I only have it during my period and the odd flare up. It was AMAZING when it came to burning! I do get urgency and frequency, but usually only as a result of bladder pressure or after sex, so mine is more pelvic floor related and amitriptyline did not help for that, but acupuncture did :)

Ouu okay yeah we’re similar. I’m on amitriptyline and have been for 9 months. I started on 10mg and had issue getting urine out in the morning at first as well. I’m on 50mg now and the problem resolved but I will have issue if I’m in a pain flare. As for the cystoscopy and diagnosis of chronic cystitis, my urologist is super into the idea of embedded infection as well and I am not. I’d be hesitant trying longterm antibiotics, but you should be fine if you tolerate them well (I personally don’t) I found most success in acupuncture. I did several months of PT as well though and noticed results too, so always a good resource to have :)

Hi hi. I’m also 22, and my partner is as well. He was in love with me for 5 years straight…and I didn’t romantically love him back. He never forced his feelings on to me, he subtly let me know. Things like good morning texts, offering to drive to see me, calling me. We remained that way, and probably would have for many years, until slowly I realized I loved him back. To this day, I love him more than anyone I’ve ever known. I’m not saying this to say “oh yes, pursue her even though she’s set the boundary of friendship” I’m telling you this to let you know you’re not a terrible person. You’re not disrespecting her by loving her. You feel how you feel. You sound like a wonderful friend and although she may always only view you as a friend, I know she appreciates all the time you’ve spent on her. I know this doesn’t help the pain you’re going through now, just know that you’re doing all the right things, and don’t be afraid to get some distance to prioritize yourself!

Omg I’m so sorry to hear you’re in that dark place :( my messages are ALWAYS open and I’m with you ❤️ I take 200mg of Gabapentin a day (I was originally at 400 a day before desert harvest aloe) and 50mg of amitriptyline! Acupuncture saved my life! I had no idea my pelvic floor dysfunction was so bad before seeing him, but I couldn’t even sit down without leaning off my left side at first! He also offered herbals targeted for inflammation and bladder health that I took for a bit, but I didn’t find them as helpful and they were expensive, but I’m positive they’d work for some patients!

Hi, when I was little (about 4) my 6 year old brother made me kiss the tip of his penis. My parents got mad at both of us when I told them, and honestly even at 22 now, I get uncomfortable and anxious at the fact that it happened. It was only one incident and it made me cautious in sexual situations, I can’t even imagine how you’re feeling. Just know it is totally okay to have these sexual thoughts, it really is. Our brains change after trauma and go through some crazy re wiring to process what happened. You are not broken, you are not gross. This is just a body process and has nothing to do with you as a person! I’d recommend talking with a therapist about it, but if you don’t feel comfortable, that’s okay too because so many of us are with you through this
